PRIVACY

Your project information.

How information submitted through this website is handled.

Information you provide

The enquiry form asks for your name, business contact information and project requirements. Optional fields help provide context. Do not include passwords, payment information or other sensitive records.

How it is used

Details are used to organize your enquiry, identify the relevant solution and prepare project follow-up. When present, campaign source fields are attached to the enquiry to identify where it originated. Submitting an enquiry does not subscribe you to promotional email.

Storage and contact

Enquiries submitted to this installation are stored on the website operator’s server. Access should be restricted to the people responsible for project enquiries. To request access, correction or deletion, contact DM_tech@yeah.net and identify your enquiry reference.

Browser preferences and external services

This website uses session storage for campaign attribution during your visit. It does not include advertising trackers or third-party analytics scripts. WhatsApp and email links open separate services with their own privacy practices. An email link creates a draft; it does not send a message automatically.

Local preview

When accessed through a localhost address, this is a local preview. Submitted enquiries are saved on that computer and are not automatically delivered to the company’s email inbox.
